rule: Publish a book only when the exact edition and every offered format/action are legally compliant in every active whitelisted region. Pending, unknown and out-of-scope jurisdictions are denied. Region removal is not clearance; scope expansion requires a supported review and explicit owner approval.
evidence_requirement: Current per-region rights plus exact text/asset-bound publication_clearance evidence, including any applicable distribution/public-domain permissions. An original-text economic-term assessment or draft preview is not publication approval.
china_scope: CN denotes Mainland China. HK, MO and TW retain their separate existing assessments and whitelist entries.
